name: My Silly Life
source: A linear visual novel about the experiences and thoughts of a young boy seeking for his place to live. Animated backgrounds and character sprites will help you fully immerse yourself in the game's history. Feel the experience of the main character, will you agree with him?
translation: 一部线性视觉小说，讲述了一个小男孩寻找自己的住处的经历和想法。动画背景和角色精灵将帮助你完全沉浸在游戏的历史中。感受一下主角的经历，你会认同他吗？
